title: Private Shuttled Coastal Gems Scenic Customizable Tour
includes: Your expert guide Julie will take as many photos of you as you want.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
If you have a child in your party under 8 years old, you must bring your own child car seat or booster seat, depending on their age. It is NOT okay for the child to sit on your lap.
You will be shuttled in a midsize car. If there are 4 adults in your party this might be uncomfortable since 3 sit in the back.
policies: This tour has slippery stairs and uneven footing; please wear shoes with good tread.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Live the California Dream and experience San Diego’s outstanding coastal scenery during your private tour, led personally by Julie Kremen, an award winning professional and certified tour guide. Read the reviews and see why she is top-rated on TripAdvisor. Besides seeing magnificent sites, you will learn what makes the area’s 70 miles of coastline so special — including learning about the culture, the history, and the lifestyles of the locals.

Breezy palm trees, captivating coastal vistas, postcard perfect cliffs, colorful beach umbrellas, hidden sea caves, picturesque ocean coves, crashing waves… Need we say more? This is the quintessential Southern California beach and seascape tour you’ve always wanted to do. 

Live the California Dream!

Note: This 4 hour private tour is fully customizable; contact Julie to book as described above or discuss how to change to suit your needs.
